title: Visit Courtesy on ClearPath Onsite Labor
content:
**Courtesy rule.** The visit courtesy on the onsite visit labor of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket reads the ticket's scope determination and issue category, both as recorded when the ticket was opened:
- a covered ticket whose category is outage, degraded service or security concern takes 10.0 percent off the labor;
- a covered ticket of any other category takes 5.0 percent off;
- a billable out of scope ticket takes nothing off.

**Points of judgement.**
- A covered ticket opened as an outage at a branch office: 10.0 percent off the visit labor.
- A covered ticket opened as a service request or a user onboarding: 5.0 percent off.
- A ticket determined billable out of scope when it was opened: nothing off, whatever its category.
